hooks.command: [ -f agents/checkpoint.sh ] || exit 0; grep -q checkpoint.sh .claude/settings.json 2>/dev/null && exit 0; bash agents/checkpoint.sh resume

SessionStart.description: agentkit checkpoint: restore mechanical state. Skipped when the project wires checkpoint.sh itself, so it never fires twice.

hooks.command: [ -f agents/checkpoint.sh ] || exit 0; grep -q checkpoint.sh .claude/settings.json 2>/dev/null && exit 0; bash agents/checkpoint.sh save

Stop.description: agentkit checkpoint: append branch, commit, dirty count, open tasks. No model runs.

hooks.command: [ -f agents/checkpoint.sh ] || exit 0; grep -q checkpoint.sh .claude/settings.json 2>/dev/null && exit 0; bash agents/checkpoint.sh close

SessionEnd.description: agentkit checkpoint: close the session record. Sessions do not end politely, so this is a floor, not the primary save.
